The appeal of a Mustang has always started with the way it feels from the driver’s seat, and this 2021 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Premium keeps that character while adding the comfort and technology needed for everyday use. Finished in Shadow Black with a premium interior and rear-wheel drive, this two-door coupe delivers classic Mustang proportions, turbocharged response, and a cabin that feels more refined than the typical entry-level sports car.
Power comes from Ford’s 2.3-liter EcoBoost four-cylinder paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission. The turbocharged engine provides strong torque through the middle of the rev range, making the car responsive in normal traffic as well as enjoyable when an open road appears. Rear-wheel drive preserves the balanced, performance-oriented layout Mustang buyers expect, while selectable drive modes and steering settings allow the car’s responses to be tailored to the road and the driver’s preference.
The automatic transmission makes this Mustang easy to live with in Tampa traffic without removing the fun from the experience. Paddle shifters provide more direct control when desired, and the coupe’s relatively compact footprint makes it easier to maneuver and park than a larger performance sedan. On a weekend drive toward Clearwater or St. Petersburg, the combination of turbocharged power, rear-wheel drive, and a low seating position gives the car the kind of personality that turns an ordinary trip into something more memorable.
EcoBoost Premium trim adds meaningful comfort. The cabin includes premium seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, push-button start, and power seat adjustment. Those features make a noticeable difference during Florida summers and help the Mustang work as a genuine daily driver rather than a car reserved only for weekends.
SYNC 3 provides touchscreen access to Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, audio functions, and voice controls. Steering-wheel controls keep common functions close at hand, while multiple drive information displays give the driver useful feedback without making the cabin feel overly complicated. The rear seat can handle occasional passengers or extra storage, and the trunk remains useful for luggage, groceries, or a weekend bag.
Safety and driver-assistance technology includes a rearview camera, automatic emergency braking, pre-collision assistance, lane-keeping technology, stability control, traction control, and antilock braking. These systems support the driver without changing the Mustang’s core identity as a rear-wheel-drive performance coupe.
This Mustang is Ford Blue Certified. The certification gives added confidence to a car that already offers a desirable mix of style, performance, and everyday comfort.
For someone who wants a sports coupe that can handle a Wesley Chapel commute during the week and still feel special on a Tampa Bay weekend, this Mustang EcoBoost Premium hits a strong middle ground. It offers the visual presence of a Mustang, the efficiency and response of turbocharged power, and enough comfort and technology to make regular ownership easy.

Safety technology is integrated throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control works in concert with traction control to manage handling in challenging conditions, while the anti-whiplash front head restraints provide additional occupant protection. Here at Lifted Trucks, this 2024 Ram 3500 Limited Crew Cab is equipped with an Icon Vehicle Dynamics 2.5" level kit paired with Fox shocks and a 4-wheel alignment, along with 22" Arena Monarch gloss black wheels, 37X12.50R22 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires, and professionally installed window tint backed by a lifetime warranty. It is finished in Billet Silver Metallic Clear Coat and includes the Night Edition package, giving the exterior a darker, more uniform appearance around the trim and badging. The dually rear axle and the large bed proportions are part of the truck's heavy-duty character, while the deployable bed step and tri-fold tonneau cover add practical details at the rear. The center high mount stop lamp with camera is integrated above the tailgate area, and the overall presentation remains consistent with the Limited trim's more refined approach.

Power comes from the Cummins HO 6.7L Turbo Diesel I6 rated at 400 hp and 1,000 lb.-ft. of torque, matched with a 3.73 axle ratio and dual alternators rated at 440 amps. This truck also includes an engine block heater, auto level rear air suspension, adaptive steering system, and dual rear wheels, all of which support the kind of work this chassis is built to handle. The 50-gallon fuel tank adds capacity between stops, and the 5th wheel/gooseneck towing prep is already in place for trailer equipment. The instrument panel mounted switch bank keeps auxiliary controls within reach, and the Protection Group is included as part of the truck's factory equipment. The Limited Level 1 Equipment Group and Quick Order Package 21M further define the truck's specification, and the combination of diesel output and chassis hardware is reinforced by the Tow Mode Camera and Trailer Surround View Camera System.

Inside, this Ram carries Limited Leather Bucket Seats and Leather Seats trim, with a cabin focused on long-distance comfort and utility. The body style places the crew cab on a heavy-duty foundation, and the stance created by the suspension and tire package sits in keeping with the Sierra 2500HD's substantial dimensions.

Inside, this Sierra combines the AT4 Premium Package and AT4 Preferred Package with leather seats, a head-up display, premium audio, and a Wi-Fi hotspot. The AT4's high-clearance step is joined by the winter grille cover and roof marker lamps, and the combination of these items makes the truck's equipment easy to identify at a glance. Each of these details is part of the vehicle's actual build, and together they point to a truck prepared for demanding use rather than one dressed with features chosen only for appearance.
